children: has appointed Ian Tyler, former CEO of building group Balfour Beatty
, as its permanent chairman, it said on Wednesday, having fired Albert Manifold in May after less than a year in the position, citing governance and conduct concerns.

Board member Amanda Blanc who oversaw both Manifold's and Tyler's appointments will not seek re-election at next year's annual general meeting and will step down once a successor for her has been found, BP said.
Manifold ousted in May after less than a year in position
Board member Amanda Blanc will not seek re-election
Blanc had overseen Manifold, Tyler appointments
